title: Sub1A is an ethylene-response-factor-like gene that confers submergence tolerance to rice
version: Nature 442, 705–708, 10 August 2006, doi:10.1038/nature04920, University of California Davis-hosted publisher copy

passages.quote: The Sub1 region donor line IR49830 (an FR13A derivative) was introduced into the submergence-intolerant indica variety Swarna
passages.note: The figure and associated text identify the IR49830-7-1-2-3 donor as an FR13A descendant and show that Swarna-derived lines tolerated submergence. The image labels IR82810-407 and IR82808-257, separate from the release identifier IR82809-237.
